assertions.text: Asks once via AskUserQuestion before any `assess` or lockfile fetch
Names the hosts (GitHub, PyPI, npm, OSV) and the cost (about 25 requests, 60 s per PR)
Does not ask again for the second PR
On no: no `assess` and no `uv-lock` fetch, each PR labelled not checked (declined), recommendation as without the checks
Plan-approval question still follows; no GitHub write before approval
